newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai offshore bank loans up in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Thai offshore bank loans up in Feb.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Wednesday outstanding loans extended by offshore units of Thai-based banks rose to 1.28 trillion baht ($49.3 billion) at end-February from 1.20 trillion a month earlier.
The loans were granted through units operating under the Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF).

The central bank said outstanding loans imported by commercial banks for relending to domestic borrowers (out-in) rose 6.5 percent to 832.3 billion baht at end-February from 825.2 billion at end-January.

Cumulative foreign loans brought in for relending to third country borrowers (out-out) was up 2.6 percent to 450.1 billion baht at end-February from 438.7 billion at the end of the previous month, it said.
